record.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. WorldSim style05 ink-and-tone BRONZE AGE game sprite. Fine controlled sepia/brown-black pen line over quiet restrained earth-colour wash. Outer contour weight twice secondary line (2:1). One broad light tone on upper-left faces, one darker lower/right shadow tone, subtle local pigment variation only. Three short crack groups per dominant stone/clay body, three broken grain lines per main plank/pole, five curved weave bands per straw surface. One small group of three parallel / hatch marks only where needed. Sparse surface marks; NO all-over hatching, stippling, granular texture or speckled wash. Upper-left daylight. Standing front three-quarter about20degrees down, substantial front face, shallow compressed top; grid-aligned square geometry, never isometric diamond. Adult56px for scale. One isolated object only, full silhouette and generous perfectly transparent margins. Outside object every pixel ALPHA ZERO, no shadow, glow, aura, haze, colored veil, ground patch, blur or backdrop; inside transparent gaps also alpha zero. No labels/text/frames/people/modern fittings/iron. No 3D rendering or pixel art. SUBJECT: one broad low dome of packed dark earth covering a radial log stack; small wood ends visible through one southern opening, tiny top vent. UNLIT, intact earth covering, no smoke. References1 props and2 scene anchor the medium and light ONLY, not camera or scenery; reference3 RouteI fixes low front3/4 camera. Opaque silhouette height32px at1x within 2x2 64px tiles; produce large source for uniform downsampling. An earthy mound like a low molehill with charcoal-making logs inside; charcoal clamp, NOT hut. Background must be empty RGBA transparency from contour to image edge. No atmospheric effects or shadow behind object.
